question: On p1, report the shared pool allocation in bytes using V$SGASTAT, with the shared pool current size in V$SGA_DYNAMIC_COMPONENTS as a fallback. If both are inaccessible, name both access gaps and explicitly say the allocation is unavailable. Do not infer runtime allocation from configured SGA targets.

groundTruth.sql: SELECT v.view_name, CASE WHEN (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM all_tab_privs WHERE table_schema='SYS' AND table_name=REPLACE(v.view_name,'V$','V_$') AND privilege='SELECT' AND grantee IN (SELECT role FROM session_roles UNION ALL SELECT USER FROM dual UNION ALL SELECT 'PUBLIC' FROM dual))=0 THEN 'unavailable' ELSE 'available' END FROM (SELECT 'V$SGASTAT' view_name FROM dual UNION ALL SELECT 'V$SGA_DYNAMIC_COMPONENTS' view_name FROM dual) v ORDER BY v.view_name
